name: Multiblock Structures: Common Recipes and Tips

pages.text: $(li)The Bee Stargate multiblock can be pasted with Building Gadget, but only non-TE blocks (sand, chevron, ring); the controller block must be placed manually.

$(li)The Empowerer consists entirely of tile entities and cannot be copied or pasted with Building Gadget.$(li)The Industrial Engineering Arc Furnace can be partially pasted (non-TE casing blocks); electrodes and controller must be placed manually.
$(li)The Roost (Chicken Coop) multiblock can be pasted, but only non-TE blocks—controllers and hoppers must be placed manually.

$(li)Blood Magic altars (ziggurat/pyramid outline, no runes) can be pasted; rune blocks must be placed manually.$(li)Astral Sorcery multiblock templates exclude tile entity blocks; actual blocks must be placed manually.$(li)Fission Reactor pastes include only non-TE structural blocks;
reactor components must be placed manually.$(li)Bewitchment multiblocks (Ritual Basement, Greenhouse, etc.) can be pasted, but ritual blocks and TE components must be placed manually.

$(li)When pasting multiblocks built with Thermal Expansion steel blocks, breaking them yields Immersive Engineering steel blocks (chiselable).$(li)Always verify which blocks in a multiblock are tile entities—those cannot be copied or pasted with Building Gadget.
